findings.title: Moved/renamed helpers removed from mark_failed with no compatibility re-exports
findings.body: This PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn` and the `HUMAN_FAILURE_*` maps from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`. Two of the functions are also renamed (`try_incident_threshold`, `create_incident_occurrence`). No test files or other callers are updated in this PR. Any existing `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import get_failure_reason` (or `mock.patch` targets on these names) will now fail with ImportError/AttributeError. Callers and tests should be updated to the new modules, or the old names re-exported from `mark_failed`.

findings.title: Computed config copy with readable schedule_type is discarded
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies the monitor config and replaces `schedule_type` with its display value. It then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the raw original) instead of the modified `config`. As a result, the occurrence's monitor context carries the raw integer schedule_type, and the transformation is dead code. This bug predates the PR but is carried into the new module.
